layers: Tool-result contract: with SPARKRING_TOOL_CHOICE_CONTRACT=1, which installer containers set by default, a Chat Completions request whose tool_choice is required or names a function, and whose output lacks a complete call to a declared function, returns HTTP 400 when the token limit ended generation and HTTP 500 otherwise, instead of HTTP 200 with empty tool_calls (runtime/images/derive_tool_choice_contract.py, FujitsuPolycom/sparkring#217). /opt/sparkring/receipts/derived-tool-choice-contract.json records the added module and the replaced serving.py

qualification_scope: Development image. Registry verification does not establish serving correctness; each profile states its own evidence scope.
